Categories.value: Transit Center at Manas|PD US Air Force|58-0094 (aircraft)

ImageDescription.value: SSgt. Eric Lacroix, 376th EAMXS, conducts a preflight inspection of a  U.S. Air Force KC-135 Stratotanker at Manas AB, Kyrgyzstan May 19.  The 376th Air Expeditionary Wing conducted a base tour and orientation flight aboard a KC-135 Stratotanker for 10 government officials of the Kyrgyz Republic. Manas AB serves as the primary mobility hub for Operation Enduring Freedom and the International Security Assistance Force by conducting air refueling of U.S. and coalition aircraft and moving people and cargo into and out of the Afghanistan area of operations.
